refnamediv.refpurpose: Compute the N-dimensional discrete Fourier transform.

listitem.para: Matrix, the input data for which the FFT is computed.
(optional) Vector specifying the dimensions of the output array.

refsection.title: Description
refsection.para: The `fftn` function computes the N-dimensional discrete Fourier transform of the input matrix `A` using a Fast Fourier Transform (FFT) algorithm. The optional `SIZE` parameter allows specifying the dimensions of the output array.
